definitions.explanation: A distinguishing quality or attribute that makes something or someone recognizable or unique. Can be positive, negative, or neutral.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特徴|とくちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please explain the features of this product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特徴|とくちょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{身長|しんちょう}→身長：03263_shinchou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: His distinguishing feature is his tall height.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{敬語|けいご}→敬語：04022_keigo⟧⟦という→と：00512_to⟧{特徴|とくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese has the characteristic of having honorific language.

notes:
USAGE: {特徴|とくちょう} describes distinctive features that help identify or characterize something. It's neutral and can apply to both positive and negative attributes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{特徴|とくちょう} (the characteristic of ~)
- {特徴|とくちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have characteristics)
- {特徴|とくちょう}⟦{的|てき}→的：noentry⟧な〜 (characteristic ~, typical ~)
- {特徴|とくちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捉|とら}える→捉える：12795_toraeru⟧ (to capture characteristics)
- {特徴|とくちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ (to make use of characteristics)

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{特長|とくちょう}→特長：00461_tokuchou⟧:
- {特徴|とくちょう} - any distinguishing feature (positive, negative, or neutral)
- ⟦{特長|とくちょう}→特長：00461_tokuchou⟧ - strong point, advantage, merit (always positive)

Both are read とくちょう but have different nuances.
